item.title: The API You Depend On Can Be Switched Off by Export Controls
item.description:
Anthropic didn’t choose to take its best models offline globally. On June 12, 2026, the U.S. Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security ordered it to — because a jailbreak had exposed a vulnerability that could help identify cyber targets, and because Anthropic couldn’t verify user nationality fast enough to comply with the resulting directive. The models went dark for everyone. Not just adversaries. Everyone.

If you build on top of frontier AI APIs, that should stop you cold.
